summary: Nothing is broken and no hard rule is breached in any of the four projects. The week's real failure was the review loop itself: no routine fired from 2026-11-05 14:22 until the Windows tasks under \Claude2\ took over on 2026-11-13, so the 2026-11-08 constellation never ran, nor did the Rising, Apothecary, Everything slots of 2026-11-09, 11-11, 11-12. Open actions stand at three, all medium refactor and release-safety work on Gnosis from its 2026-11-14 review. Apothecary v1.3.6 is built and tested in the working tree and waits on Kane's go to ship.

topActions.label: Make scripts/push-to-github.ps1 refuse a tree with dirty paths outside the release's own files unless given an explicit path list, using the pattern at release.ps1 lines 716 to 730.
Write the end state and a line budget for web/worker.js and web/build.mjs into PROJECT_SPEC.md, then close extraction work against that budget.
Extract the next self-contained stage of web/build.mjs into a pure module with its own test.
Make the Everything status writer stamp a release version or null rather than a commit hash, then drop the Everything skip in scripts/audit-dashboard-page.py.
Run the dashboard page audit again; the newest, docs/DASHBOARD_AUDIT-2026-09-23.md, is 53 days old.
Give the four Everything hard rules a `hard_rule_checks` entry each; the field is null today, so every review checks them by hand.
Point the nightly Rising audit at a Godot executable so the campaign fingerprint gate runs again; its last real pass was 2026-11-11 at 6e97d14.
Promote the two longest-running tensions to decision records: Apothecary compliance against strategic-kill-this (9 runs) and Gnosis architecture against maintainability (7 runs).
